description: Published items of one publication, newest first, optionally between two dates, with paging. Use for browsing what a publication ran in a week, month or year. VI Update articles are dated by the date the article shows; Good Day and Straight Record editions by their publication date.

date_from.description: Earliest date, inclusive: a year (2026), a month (2026-10) or a day (2026-10-05).

date_to.description: Latest date, inclusive: a year, a month (its last day) or a day.

offset.description: How many items to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

section.description: Which publication: "vi_update" (VI Update articles), "good_day" (Good Day, This Week editions) or "straight_record" (The Straight Record editions).

name: list_items
title: List items by date
